input.quote: 12.4 Customer shall not solicit, hire, or employ any Vendor employee during the term or for twenty-four months afterward, regardless of how the employee applies.
input.rationale: § 12.4 binds only Customer, includes a no-hire ("solicit, hire, or employ"), covers all Vendor employees for 24 months post-term, and expressly negates any unsolicited-approach or general-advertising carve-out ("regardless of how the employee applies") — all three walk-away triggers, and inconsistent with § 12.3 (Vendor acknowledges Customer has made no no-hire commitment and may hire anyone responding to general recruitment). The repaired redline reaches the fallback with three surgical substitutions to the existing sentence rather than a rewrite: "Neither party" (mutual) and "solicit" only (no-hire deleted), scope limited to employees directly involved in the Services, duration cut to 12 months running from the end of that involvement, and an express carve-out for general recruitment not targeted at the other party's personnel and for unsolicited approaches. Preferred position (deletion) is retained as the opening ask in the comment.

proposal.summary: Narrow § 12.4 by surgical edits: mutual, solicitation-only, Services personnel, 12 months, general-recruitment carve-out
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have narrowed § 12.4 to the mutual, solicitation-only form we can accept: personnel directly involved in the Services, 12 months from the end of that involvement, with carve-outs for general recruitment and unsolicited approaches. As drafted it was a one-way 24-month no-hire over all Vendor employees that ignored unsolicited applications and contradicted § 12.3; our preference remains to delete the clause entirely.

ops.oldText: Customer shall not solicit, hire, or employ any Vendor employee
ops.newText: Neither party shall solicit any employee of the other party directly involved in the Services

ops.oldText: regardless of how the employee applies
ops.newText: except in response to general recruitment not targeted at that party's personnel or an unsolicited approach
